results.corrected_title: Nvidia board unanimously reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO; stock jumps 31.5%
results.corrected_summary: Nvidia's board unanimously reinstated Jensen Huang as president, CEO and director, effective immediately. The press release is dated Nov 23, and the 8-K lists Nov 22 as the event date. Huang had resigned on Nov 12, and the board had said it did not plan to reinstate him. The board said it consulted senior US government officials and concluded the move poses no national security risk. Shares rose 31.5% on Nov 23, the biggest gain in over two decades, then fell 5.9% on Nov 24.
key_facts: Board received input from senior US government officials and concluded no national security risk
Committee of independent directors investigates reports that Huang was target of a foreign intelligence effort
National Security and Export Control Committee was announced Nov 17, before the reinstatement
Shares +31.5% on Nov 23 (biggest gain in 20+ years), -5.9% on Nov 24 (AP)
Harvey C. Jones remains board chair; Colette Kress returns to CFO only
results.issues: National security committee predates reinstatement. Resignation date from search summary.
